pooled.span: The overall pooled results of the complete case analysis of 42 studies (reporting on 11 305 participants) ( figure 3 ), comparing probiotics with any control, favoured probiotics demonstrating a statistically significant reduction in the incidence of AAD. The pooled RR of 0.63 (RR=0.63 (95% CI 0.54 to 0.73), p<0.00001)

scope_note: Topic primary outcome: Antibiotic-associated diarrhoea. Overall complete-case AAD analysis is closest. All included studies report AAD, but definitions/control types differ. Table reference labels preserved; no split-arm counts reconstructed. Model proposal declares the listed source set complete for the selected comparator outcome; this is not a claim of eligibility equivalence with our pool.
not_found: SCOPE_MISMATCH: any control includes no-treatment; definitions and complete-case populations vary.
TRIAL_VALUES_INCOMPLETE: null identifiers, arm counts and trial effects were not unambiguously printed/bound in selected spans.
